verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no user-definable rules or event-triggered automations in ELSTER. MeinELSTER+'s automatic preparation of tax returns is a fixed vendor feature, not rules a user defines to fire actions on events. Postfach delegation and third-party tax software are adjacent features that earn no credit. The axis applies to an online tax portal, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
